args.summary: The device FX-RAM-01 (fx-latitude-ram, Dell Latitude 7440) currently has 16 GB RAM and shows persistent RAM constraint (95%+ usage in 10 of 14 daily snapshots). An upgrade proposal for 128 GB RAM was rejected because 128 GB is not an allowed specification; the allowed RAM upgrade options are 16, 32, or 64 GB.

claims.text: Device FX-RAM-01 has 16 GB total RAM and 97.5% RAM usage on the latest snapshot (2026-06-12).
The ram_constrained insight confirms persistent high RAM usage: 10 of 14 snapshots at or above 95% (share 0.71, max consecutive 3 days).
Creating an upgrade order for 128 GB RAM failed with PRECONDITION_FAILED: allowed RAM specs are 16, 32, 64 GB.

caveats: One RAM reading per day: high usage at that moment, not proof of sustained memory pressure.
